faq.q: Can characters gain or lose weight in GTA VI?
faq.a: Yes. WIRED reports that eating and working out affect the characters' weight and physique, shown via eating and exercise minigames in the Extended Look video.

faq.q: How is the body weight and physique system shown in the Extended Look?
faq.a: WIRED describes it as character customization and reactivity, demonstrated through eating and exercise minigames rather than a menu screen.

faq.q: What does WIRED call the physique change in GTA VI?
faq.a: WIRED's coverage describes characters getting "swole" as a result of the working out shown in the video.

faq.q: Does this system affect both Jason and Lucia?
faq.a: The facts file does not specify which protagonist is shown using the eating and exercise minigames, only that the system is shown in the video.
